title: Mini Barrier Restore Cream Comforting Daily Moisturizer
descriptionHtml:
✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Non-Comedogenic✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Fragrance Free

What it is: A rich yet lightweight cream moisturizer to comfort and soothe the skin barrier.


Skin Type: Normal, Dry, Combination, and Oily


Skincare Concerns: Dryness, Dullness, and Uneven Texture


Formulation: Cream


How to Use+

Suggested Usage:

-After morning/evening cleansing, apply 1/2 finger-length amount onto face, neck, and décolleté. 

-For best results, layer on top of Glazing Milk and Peptide Glazing Fluid as the last step in your routine.

Ingredients+

- Peptides: Short chains of amino acids that reduce the look of fine lines.

- Shea Butter: Hydrates and moisturizes with 5 essential fatty acids.

- Hyaluronic Acid: High molecular weight HA draws in hydration and replenishes skin.


water/aqua/eau, glycerin, caprylic/capric triglyceride, butyrospermum parkii (shea) butter, behenyl alcohol, xylitylglucoside, niacinamide, squalane, sodium acrylates copolymer, acetyl tetrapeptide-2, palmitoyl heptapeptide-27, palmitoyl oligopeptide-78, palmitoyl octapeptide-24, phenoxyethanol, anhydroxylitol, 1,2-hexanediol, hydroxyethyl acrylate/sodium acryloyldimethyl taurate copolymer, xylitol, lecithin, ethylhexylglycerin, glucose, bisabolol, sodium hyaluronate, teprenone, polysorbate 60, sorbitan isostearate, caprylyl glycol, euterpe oleracea fruit extract, potassium sorbate, citric acid, sorbic acid, lactic acid/glycolic acid copolymer, tocopherol, polyvinyl alcohol, sodium hydroxide.


The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
